[LTIM.14.3] **A call over constants is a constant.** A `calendar` call whose
arguments all fold is foldable ([LEXP.8.8]), so `const LAUNCH =
calendar.time(2026, 1, 1)` declares a `Time` constant. The compiler must
refuse a `const` whose fold would raise [LTIM.14.2]'s fault, with
`DS_VALIDATE_CONST_NOT_FOLDABLE`: the call has no value to fold to. Outside a
`const`, the engine evaluates the call when the rule runs, and a call that
raises raises there.
